description: This file contains the implementation of a reconciler for managing EndpointSlice resources in Kubernetes, including functions for reconciling, creating, updating, deleting EndpointSlices, and handling Endpoint resources.

classes.name: reconciler
classes.description: A struct responsible for reconciling EndpointSlice resources with Endpoints, managing creation, updates, and deletions.

methods.name: reconcile
methods.description: Main method to reconcile Endpoint resources with EndpointSlices, creating, updating, or deleting slices as needed.

methods.name: reconcileByPortMapping
methods.description: Compares existing EndpointSlices with desired endpoints and determines slices to create, update, or delete.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Performs creation, update, and deletion of EndpointSlices based on reconciliation decisions.

methods.name: deleteEndpoints
methods.description: Deletes EndpointSlices associated with a given Endpoints resource.

methods.name: endpointSlicesByKey
methods.description: Groups EndpointSlices by a key based on address type and ports.

methods.name: totalChanges
methods.description: Calculates the number of added, updated, and removed endpoints needed to match desired state.

methods.name: needRebuildExistingSlices
methods.description: Determines if an existing EndpointSlice needs to be rebuilt based on owner references.
